response.overview: It takes sixty minutes to play a full game of football, but sometimes it all comes down to the final two. In Two Minutes to Glory, NFL Films looks back at legendary games that were decided by the last two minutes. See how some of the 'masters' of the two minute drill, like John Elway or Peyton Manning, brought their team back to victory. In-depth interviews from players and coaches bring you insight on how these miracluous moments were made possible. Even the biggest game of them all, the Super Bowl, has had its fair share of nail biting finishes. With Two Minutes to Glory you will see improbable victories, excruciating defeats, and see how legends are born.
response.title: NFL: Two Minutes To Glory
